name: MithrilUI Tuned
$comment: Everything in `default`, plus the two layout modules: a straightened
toolbar with the store button removed, and enlarged morale/power bars.
Build for your own resolution or the whole thing lands wrong:
READ THIS BEFORE USING IT. Positions written by a skin override the
game's own UI layout tool, so Ctrl+\ can no longer move the toolbar or
the vitals panel. That is inherent to skin-side positioning. If you would
rather keep them movable, stay on `default`.
The numbers below are computed or estimated, not measured off a client.
Expect one round of nudging. The ones most likely to need it are

options.$toolbar: Widths are generous on purpose: too wide only adds empty space, too narrow clips buttons.
options.$vitals: Roughly double the stock bar length. vitalBarLeft leaves room for the portrait.
